about: Known loop and collapse triggers, each with where it was seen and what the loop handling must do with it. probes.py sends each one and checks its expectation. expect: clean = finishes by itself with no degenerate run; bounded = may degenerate, but must stop with finish_reason repetition before its run passes max_run tokens; kept = legitimate repetition that must finish by itself, never with finish_reason repetition.
